{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in customer_segment and channel
print("Unique values in customer_segment:", sales_df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Unique values in channel:", sales_df['channel'].unique())

# Check the cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n", cross_tab)

# Confirm that all 'new' customers are in 'paid_search' and all 'paid_search' customers are 'new'
new_in_paid_search = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]
all_paid_search_new = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search']['customer_segment'].eq('new').all()
all_new_paid_search = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new']['channel'].eq('paid_search').all()

print(f"All paid_search customers are new: {all_paid_search_new}")
print(f"All new customers are in paid_search: {all_new_paid_search}")"}
